fields.summary_ko.0: Google is reducing 2027 Broadcom-designed TPU 8i series shipments by approximately 1 million units (approximately 20% versus prior-year plan) and promoting increased MediaTek-designed TPU 8t series shipments, according to analyst Kuo.
fields.summary_ko.1: This appears to reflect Google's prioritization of frontier AI model development and chip portfolio adjustment amid data center power constraints, with negative implications for Broadcom and positive implications for MediaTek.
